uplink.description: Measurement frame, leak detected (digital input bit0 high)
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds frame; expected computed by running reference/upstream-codec.js (entree value [[1],[0],[0],[0]]) and normalizing input bit0 -> water.leak. The digital-input TLV is not positional (upstream names it plain `entree`, no voie suffix), so water.leak stays top-level and no channels array is emitted.

uplink.description: Measurement frame, no leak, with water temperature 21.50 degC on voie0
uplink._note: Synthetic; reference decodes entree [[0],[0],[0],[0]] and temperature0 21.5 degC voie '0' (0x0866=2150 /100). bit0 low -> water.leak=false (top-level); the temperature is scoped into its voie's channels entry.

uplink.description: Multi-position measurement frame: two temperature voies (voie0 21.50, voie1 18.25)
uplink._note: Synthetic; verified against reference/upstream-codec.js: temperature0 value 21.5 voie '0' (marker 0x08 -> channel 0, 0x0866=2150) and temperature1 value 18.25 voie '1' (marker 0x18 -> channel 1, 0x0721=1825). This is the frame the previous suffixed shape collapsed: both voies were written to the same water.temperature.current, so only the last (18.25) survived.

uplink.description: Multi-position frame with a faulted voie: voie0 sentinel skipped, voie1 18.25 kept
uplink._note: Synthetic; verified against reference/upstream-codec.js: temperature0 value 'erreur' voie '0' (0x8000 = -32768 -> -327.68 degC sentinel), temperature1 18.25 voie '1', entree [[1],[0],[0],[0]]. Sentinel policy: the faulted voie gets no entry (never a bogus -327.68) and is named in a warning; healthy voies still report.

uplink.description: Life/keep-alive frame, battery 3.600 V, supply 3.400 V
uplink._note: Synthetic; reference decodes tensionv 3.6 V (0x0E10=3600 /1000) and tensionc 3.4 V (0x0D48=3400 /1000). tensionv -> battery; tensionc -> chargeVoltage extra. Both whole-device, so no channels array.

uplink.description: Measurement frame whose only voie faults yields an error

errors: measurement frame contained no recognized channels

uplink._note: Synthetic; reference decodes temperature0 value 'erreur' voie '0' and nothing else. With every voie faulted and no digital-input line in the frame, there is no reading to publish.
Synthetic; reference frame type 'Trame d'erreur' with ERR_BATTERY_LEVEL_LOW (0x95) and battery 3.6 V; normalized to an error result.
